title: CM-03 population, completeness and accuracy checks, and a reproducible sample
area: Audit domain: ITGCs, populations, sampling, evidence
scenario: Before ControlPilot tests anything, internal audit at MFH must define the CM-03 population (every production change in the interim period, by local date), reconcile it to DeployHub's control total, test the export's accuracy, size the sample from the firm's table and draw it reproducibly. Deterministic code, no model.
task: Build the population from the deploy log with local-date boundaries, collapsing re-deploys
Keep unmerged and off-main changes in the population as flagged items
Reconcile to the control total and write the IPE accuracy checks
Size the sample from the table and select it with a recorded seed and a population hash
acceptance: Both period boundaries right in America/Chicago; failed and non-prod runs excluded
Population reconciles (220) and the three seeded accuracy findings are reported
Selection reproducible, order independent and exactly the documented method
ANSWER.md makes the IPE argument and handles the findings

Week 2 Thu - sampling by control frequency
